control.Description:
Professional local YOLO vision model workspace
C++ and Qt 6.8.3 desktop application with bundled CPU PyTorch runtime.
Supports YOLO .pt and ONNX image, video, camera inference and result exports.
Grayscale input adapts to one or three model channels; side-by-side streams
can preview and infer the left or right eye independently.
Built for Ubuntu 22.04 LTS amd64. Runtime assets reside in /opt/VisionStudio
by default; results and settings are stored separately for each user.
